# `noya account`

_Wallet identity + signing (signMessage / signTransaction / signTypedData)._

**6 commands** in this group.

### `noya account address`

Resolved Ethereum address from /api/me. Throws if anonymous

_No flags._

### `noya account polymarket-address`

Derive the Polymarket Safe address (CREATE2) for the user's EOA. Mirrors `noya_get_polymarket_address` MCP tool — pure local derivation, no network call beyond the one /api/me to resolve the EOA

_No flags._

### `noya account to-viem`

Returns a viem `LocalAccount` whose signing methods POST to signer. Memoized — same Account instance always returns the same viem account

_No flags._
